reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI frontier as marker of global inequality
themes.definition: Being at the frontier of AI is presented as a privilege of rich nations, contrasted with poverty and crisis elsewhere.
themes.inclusion: Passages using AI access or leadership as a marker of the divide between advantaged and disadvantaged nations.
themes.exclusion: Passages naming AI only as a challenge without an inequality contrast.
themes.boundary_cases: Brief AI references inside a 'two worlds' inequality narrative count here even without policy proposals.

examples.quote: They are at the frontier of the artificial intelligence and other emerging technologies with expanding digital infrastructure and rising standards of living.

themes.label: AI listed among multilateral challenges
themes.definition: AI named in a list of global challenges requiring multilateralism, without elaboration.
themes.inclusion: Passages listing AI challenges alongside climate, nuclear weapons and SDGs.
themes.exclusion: Passages that develop specific AI risks or proposals.
themes.boundary_cases: A reference to the Global Digital Compact in the same list may additionally be coded AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: To tackle successfully the growing challenges of artificial intelligence.

themes.label: Global Digital Compact as guide
themes.definition: UN frameworks such as the Global Digital Compact and Pact for the Future cited as guides for technology challenges.
themes.inclusion: Passages invoking the Global Digital Compact or Pact for the Future in connection with AI.
themes.boundary_cases: When cited only within a long list, code together with list mention.

examples.quote: be guided by the global digital compact and the pact for the future

value.rationale: Two Caribbean opening passages mention AI only briefly: Dominica uses AI frontier status to illustrate global inequality, while Saint Vincent lists AI among challenges for multilateralism with reference to the Global Digital Compact.
